archetype: Pastel & Soft with Playful Storybook Charm (Kid-Friendly & Parent-Trustworthy)

overview.mission: Localized quarterly book rental membership for kids & parents — 4 fresh books every month (12 total/quarter) delivered to your door with WhatsApp magic, effortless swap-cycles, and zero clutter.
overview.retheme_vision: Whole-site playful retheme: soft storybook cream canvas, sky blue horizons, fresh leaf green accents, sunny warm yellow highlights, friendly chunky rounded shapes (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl), playful sticker badges, wiggly underlines, cloud/wave dividers, and upbeat parent-trustworthy micro-interactions. All functional flows (pincode checks, 4-book dock, mock checkout, dashboard due countdowns, WhatsApp log, toys waitlist, auth) stay completely intact.

css_import_instructions: Set --font-heading: 'Poppins', sans-serif; --font-display: 'Poppins', sans-serif; --font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif;

hierarchy_rules.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.15]
hierarchy_rules.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold font-heading tracking-tight text-slate-900

entry_surfaces./: storybook split hero — friendly headline, value pillars + pincode bar left, floating pastel book stack and badge showcase right
entry_surfaces./catalog: playful book library — pill filter ribbon top, 4-book live bundle dock sticky bottom, responsive grid of colorful book cards with age tags
entry_surfaces./subscription: membership plan card & mock checkout — sunny ₹1,499 quarterly highlight, WhatsApp perks badge, trust seals and address step
entry_surfaces./dashboard: child & parent command center — current 4-book shelf with due countdown pill, swap request CTA, and WhatsApp message log feed
entry_surfaces./login: storybook split login — soft sky illustrated perks panel left, chunky card form right
entry_surfaces./signup: storybook split signup — membership benefits banner left, 3-step chunky card form right
entry_surfaces./forgot-password: storybook centered recovery card — friendly lock glyph, email input, back-to-login pill
entry_surfaces./reset-password: storybook centered password reset card — key glyph, password inputs, secure confirmation button

playful_decorative_motifs.wiggly_underline: Use a subtle yellow/sky wavy SVG underline under key words like 'Unlimited Reading', 'Zero Screen Guilt', 'Happy Kids'
playful_decorative_motifs.clouds_and_waves: Gentle SVG curved wave dividers (`text-[#F0F9FF]` or `text-[#FDFBF7]`) between major sections instead of straight cuts
playful_decorative_motifs.stars_and_sparkles: Small Lucide icon accents (`Sparkles`, `Star`, `BookOpen`, `Smile`, `Heart`) with soft pastel circle badges behind them
playful_decorative_motifs.sticker_tags: Rotate small tags by -2deg or +3deg with bouncy hover transition to feel like cute stickers

motion_and_interactions.dock_item_add: motion.div scale from 0.8 to 1 with spring bounce (stiffness: 400, damping: 25)
motion_and_interactions.notification_pop: slide-in from bottom with gentle overshoot
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap custom motion in (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) conditionals and ensure all items remain accessible without motion

copy_tone_and_examples.tone: Upbeat, warm, storybook-friendly, encouraging for kids, reassuring and crystal clear for Indian parents

headlines.hero: Fuel Little Imaginations with Fresh Books Every Month 📚✨
headlines.subhero: Curated 4-book monthly bundles delivered to your doorstep in Mumbai & Bangalore. Swap whenever you're ready — no late fees, zero clutter!
headlines.whatsapp_pitch: Track delivery & swaps easily on WhatsApp — hassle-free for busy parents
headlines.toys_teaser: Toy Trunk is Coming Soon! 🧸 Wooden Montessori toys, STEM puzzles & games

Home.hero_section: Light cream background (#FDFBF7) with soft sky blue (#F0F9FF) and sunshine yellow (#FEFCE8) ambient blobs. Left side: Friendly Poppins headline, 3 quick benefit pills ('Curated for Ages 2-12', 'Sanitized & Inspected', 'Instant WhatsApp Support'), and the Pincode checker input in a chunky pill container. Right side: Playful book collage with kid photo cards, floating '4 Books/Mo' badge and star accents.
Home.pincode_checker: Chunky white pill box with 2px sky-200 border, map pin icon, 6-digit input, and bright sky-600 'Check Delivery' button with instant green/amber feedback chip.
Home.how_it_works: 4-step playful story track (1. Pick 4 Books -> 2. Doorstep Delivery -> 3. Read & Enjoy -> 4. Free Swap on WhatsApp) featuring friendly step number stickers (1, 2, 3, 4) in colorful circles.
Home.value_props: Grid of 3 soft-tinted cards: Mint green ('Sanitized & Child-Safe'), Sky blue ('₹125/Book vs ₹400 MRP'), Sunshine yellow ('Zero Late Fees & Easy Returns').
Home.social_proof: Parent testimonials with 5 gold stars, child's age badge (e.g. 'Mom to Kabir, Age 5'), and friendly quote bubbles.

Catalog.header: Playful banner with search bar & age filters ('All', 'Ages 2-4 (Board Books)', 'Ages 5-7 (Early Readers)', 'Ages 8-10 (Chapter Books)', 'Ages 11-14 (Young Adults)') styled as chunky toggle pills.
Catalog.grid: 3-column responsive grid of books with colorful category badges, reading level indicator, book cover image, and chunky '+ Add to Box' button that turns into green '✓ Added' when selected.
Catalog.dock: Sticky floating bottom dock showing 4 slots with miniature thumbnails, counter ('3/4 Books Selected'), and bright 'Confirm Box' CTA.

Subscription.plan_card: Sunny gold highlight card for ₹1,499 Quarterly Plan (3 Months), broken down to '₹499/month · 12 books total'. Includes bullet points with green checkmarks.
Subscription.checkout_steps: Friendly step-by-step accordion: 1. Delivery Address & Pincode -> 2. WhatsApp Number for Updates -> 3. Payment Option (Mock Razorpay / UPI / Card / Cash on Delivery).
Subscription.trust_badges: 100% money-back guarantee seal, sanitized book badge, parent-approved lock.

Dashboard.welcome_banner: Sunny sky card: 'Welcome back, [Parent Name]! Kabir's Reading Box is Active 📖'
Dashboard.current_books: 4-card row of active books with days remaining countdown badge ('📅 Return/Swap in 12 days') and one-click 'Request Return & Swap' chunky button.
Dashboard.whatsapp_log: Friendly WhatsApp mock chat card with green header, timestamped status updates ('Your 4 books were dispatched!', 'Swap reminder sent to +91 98765 43210').
Dashboard.reading_stats: Playful milestone badges ('12 Books Read this Quarter', 'Super Explorer Badge').

Auth_Pages.Login_Signup: Two-column split card on soft cream page. Left column: Pastel illustrated reading perks panel with cheerful badges. Right column: White card with rounded-2xl inputs, prominent labels, show/hide password toggle, and chunky sky-600 submit button.
Auth_Pages.ForgotPassword_ResetPassword: Centered friendly card with pastel lock/key icon in a soft circle, clear explanation, and instant feedback alerts.

Toys_Teaser.banner: Lavender/Mint pastel banner teasing 'RentARead Toys Trunk' with waitlist email signup and chunky 'Join Waitlist' button.

accessibility_and_wcag.contrast_guarantee: All text elements meet WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1 ratio). Sky blue buttons use deep saturated #0284C7 or #0369A1 on white text (ratio 4.8:1+). Dark slate #0F172A and #1E293B are used for all headers and body text against #FDFBF7 and white cards (ratio 12:1+).
accessibility_and_wcag.focus_states: All inputs and buttons feature prominent focus ring `focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-200 focus:outline-none`.
accessibility_and_wcag.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, badges, and counters MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="pincode-input"`, `data-testid="add-to-bundle-button"`, `data-testid="bundle-dock"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font imports in `frontend/src/index.css` with `@import "@fontsource/poppins/400.css"; @import "@fontsource/poppins/600.css"; @import "@fontsource/poppins/700.css"; @import "@fontsource-variable/dm-sans";` and update `--font-heading`, `--font-display`, `--font-sans` variables.

2. Update the `:root` theme variables in `frontend/src/index.css` with the pastel storybook palette tokens (background: #FDFBF7, primary: #0284C7, secondary: #F0F9FF, accent: #16A34A, ring: #0284C7, radius: 1rem).

3. Replace the editorial terracotta/serif elements across Home, Catalog, Subscription, Dashboard, Auth, and ToysTeaser with rounded-3xl cards, chunky pill buttons, pastel category pills, and Lucide icons.
4. Ensure the light theme remains bright and cheerful without dark photo overlays, keeping full parent-trustworthy readability.
5. Keep all backend endpoints, Pydantic models, data stores, and React router URLs identical so existing tests continue passing seamlessly.
6. Verify every interactive component has explicit `data-testid` attributes.
